security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.longDescription: Aggregates local agent activity from Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, OpenCode, WorkBuddy (desktop + web), CodeBuddy, Doubao (豆包), Doubao Work (豆包工作), MiniMax Code (including Local Storage / config), and Trae (ByteDance) into a single timeline with Eisenhower planning. v0.3.0 adds a 4-quadrant Eisenhower matrix on the Planner page, an at-a-glance top-3 Q1 brief on the home page (refreshed daily at 8 am via launchd), one-click promote-to-Daily for urgent+important items, and LLM or heuristic fallback for the digest classifier.
